title: Why Is Madeira's South Coast Calmer for Boat Trips Than the North?
description: The island blocks the north-east trade wind and the big North Atlantic swells, so the south coast sits in the lee. How the shelter works, and when it fails.
heroAlt: Flat sea off Madeira's south coast with trade wind clouds resting on the mountain ridge
keywords: why is Madeira's south coast calmer than the north

A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy sits small in the lower corner, its wake a thin white line. Realistic photo, true colours, no text.
